title: Slow
description: Whenever you play a card, this enemy receives [blue]10%[/blue] more damage from Attacks this turn.
smart_description: Whenever you play a card, this enemy receives [blue]10%[/blue] more damage from Attacks this turn. (Receives [blue]10% per card played[/blue] more damage cumulative)
notes: Slow counter resets at the start of each enemy turn. Each card played by the player increases the counter by 1, with each stack providing 10% additional damage to Attacks. DisplayAmount is shown as SlowAmount × 10 (the percentage).
